title: Graceful Shutdown with Signal Handling and In‑Flight Request Drain
description: Adds support for SIGINT, SIGTERM and SIGQUIT to allow the server to stop accepting new connections while waiting for in‑flight requests to finish. This prevents abrupt termination, protects data integrity and improves reliability in production environments.
testCases: Simulate SIGTERM and verify server stops accepting new connections but completes existing ones before exit
Trigger SIGINT during a long‑running request and ensure the request resolves successfully before process exits
acceptance: Server must log shutdown initiation, stop accepting new requests within 100 ms, wait up to 5 seconds for active requests to finish, then exit with code 0; if timeout expires, force exit with code 1. All related tests pass and no regressions in existing test suite.
reason: Production deployments need reliable termination to avoid data loss and abrupt client errors, especially in container orchestration platforms where pods are frequently stopped and restarted.
